hero.sub: Private execution for large crypto volumes. Firm quotes, competitive spreads and same-day settlement.
manifesto.label: What is OTC
manifesto.text: Large volumes don't belong in the order book. On an OTC desk, every trade is negotiated privately — price locked before execution, no slippage, no moving the market. That's how institutions, companies and large portfolios buy and sell crypto.

services.label: Services
services.c1.title: High-volume buying & selling
services.c1.text: Block execution for volumes the open market can't absorb, with a firm quote and a single price for the entire trade.
services.c2.title: Deep liquidity
services.c2.text: Simultaneous access to multiple global liquidity venues to guarantee the best price, at any trade size.
services.c3.title: Fast, secure settlement
services.c3.text: Same-day settlement (T+0) in fiat or crypto, with full confirmation and end-to-end traceability.
services.c4.title: Dedicated coverage
services.c4.text: A specialist follows every trade from start to finish. No queues, no tickets, no bots.
process.label: How it works
process.s1.title: Contact
process.s1.text: You talk directly to the desk through your preferred channel — asset, volume and direction of the trade.
process.s2.title: Firm quote
process.s2.text: Within minutes you receive a single, locked price for the full volume. No surprises at execution.
process.s3.title: Execution
process.s3.text: Accepted, executed. The entire trade closes at once, away from the public order book.
process.s4.title: Settlement
process.s4.text: Assets and funds settle the same day, with complete end-to-end confirmation.
security.label: Security & Compliance
security.i1.title: KYC & AML
security.i1.text: Strict identity verification and anti-money-laundering processes on every single trade.
security.i2.title: Segregated custody
security.i2.text: Assets held in segregated structures, with multi-level access controls.
security.i3.title: Audit trail
security.i3.text: Contracts, receipts and complete records for every trade, from first contact to settlement.
security.i4.title: Confidentiality
security.i4.text: Your trades never appear in any public book. Absolute discretion, from start to finish.
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.a1: OTC (over-the-counter) means trading directly between two parties, outside exchanges. For large volumes, that means a locked price, zero slippage and total privacy.
faq.q2: What is the minimum trade size?
faq.a2: Trades start at R$ 100k. Below that, a traditional exchange tends to be more efficient for your case.
faq.a3: Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and the market's leading crypto assets. Other assets on request.
faq.a4: You share the asset and volume; the desk returns a firm price, valid for a short window. Once accepted, the price is locked for the entire trade.
faq.q5: How fast does the trade settle?
faq.a5: In the vast majority of cases, same business day (T+0), in fiat or crypto, depending on the direction of the trade.
faq.q6: What do I need to start trading?
faq.a6: A simple onboarding with KYC verification — individual or corporate documents. Once approved, the desk is at your disposal.
